items.summary: This research presents HXAI, a hierarchical and privacy-preserving explainable AI framework for distributed energy systems. It aims to provide fine-grained insights into household energy consumption while managing peak loads and designing resilient grids.

items.title: Hypothesis-guided discovery of cognitive algorithms via program refinement
items.summary: This research explores hypothesis-guided discovery of cognitive algorithms through program refinement to develop cognitive models from behavioral data. It addresses the challenge of building flexible and scalable interpretable models in cognitive science.

items.title: Answering clinicians' questions over trial evidence tables with verifiable, feedback-driven language models
items.summary: This paper introduces FD-SCoPE, a system using verifiable, feedback-driven language models to answer clinicians' questions from trial evidence tables. It aims to provide more flexible and comprehensive querying than traditional database approaches.

items.title: Labels Override Definitions in Jev-Style Typed Decision Models
items.summary: This research examines how labels can override explicit definitions in Jev-style typed decision models, which answer fixed questions with probabilities for caller-defined options. It explores an interface where developers state rules but labels can influence model behavior.

items.title: Designing the Future of User Feedback for Generative AI
items.summary: This paper explores the design of user feedback mechanisms for generative AI systems, emphasizing their role in monitoring, improving, and increasing user engagement and trust. It discusses effective implementation strategies for post-deployment feedback.

items.title: Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen LLM Hear Beyond the Transcript
items.summary: This paper proposes DuplexJev, a novel method for full-duplex voice agents that allows a frozen LLM to make batched speech decisions by reading ASR-encoder hidden states as a single-token distribution, rather than through slow autoregressive decoding.

items.title: DataWeave: Deploying Human-LLM Analytics for Exploratory Structured Data Analysis
items.summary: This work introduces DataWeave, a system that deploys human-LLM analytics for exploratory structured data analysis, specifically tailored to assist data journalists in uncovering trends and narratives.

items.title: Large language models exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves
items.summary: This study evaluates the reliability of large language models in clinical reasoning, finding that LLMs exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves over time.

items.title: Learning to Revise Reasoning with Segment-wise On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: This research introduces Segment-wise On-Policy Distillation (OPD), a method designed to improve large language model reasoning by enabling students to revise their reasoning steps with coherent, segment-wise supervision from a teacher.

items.title: Label-Efficient Time Series Classification at Scale: A Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM with Counterfactual Attribution
items.summary: This research introduces a Dual-Stream OSSE-LSTM with Counterfactual Attribution for label-efficient time series classification, addressing the challenge of limited label volume in large-scale time series analytics.

items.title: Law And Order: Tax Law Autoformalization
items.summary: This paper investigates 'Tax Law Autoformalization,' a method for translating legal texts, specifically tax laws, into accurate symbolic representations to facilitate their implementation through software systems.

items.title: PAPER2LLM++: Continual Self-Evolution of LLMs from Research Papers
items.summary: This paper introduces PAPER2LLM++, a framework that enables large language models (LLMs) to achieve continual self-evolution by automatically learning from new research papers about their own limitations and solutions.

items.title: BitNest: Bit-Nested Speculative Decoding for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference Acceleration
items.summary: This research presents BitNest, a bit-nested speculative decoding method for memory-efficient LLM inference acceleration that optimizes autoregressive generation without significant memory overhead.

items.title: VIGOR: Zero-Shot Visual Generalization via Latent-Space Consistency in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This work introduces VIGOR, a method for achieving zero-shot visual generalization in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) through latent-space consistency, addressing performance degradation under unseen visual distractions.

items.title: MetaRubric: Learning to Reward for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This research introduces MetaRubric, a method for 'Learning to Reward' in rubric-based reinforcement learning, addressing issues where human rubric judges may assign high scores despite missing information or actions.

items.title: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
items.summary: This paper proposes Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR), a framework that uses a base model (Qwen-3.8-27B) to discover successful trajectories for complex tasks, thereby enabling model improvement through self-supervision.

items.title: FSPO: Policy-Consistent Risk and Pareto-Feasible Control for Budgeted LLM RL Post-Training
items.summary: This paper introduces FSPO, a method for policy-consistent risk and Pareto-feasible control in budgeted LLM reinforcement learning post-training, addressing challenges in adaptive LLM training.

items.title: Hybrid Machine Learning-Assisted Raman Spectroscopy with Generative Feature Augmentation for Pharmaceutical Identification
items.summary: HyMLRaman is a hybrid machine learning framework combining deep spectral feature extraction and generative augmentation for Raman spectroscopy to rapidly and reliably identify pharmaceutical residues. It is designed to improve public health and food safety applications.

items.title: The Price of Greenwashing: Algorithmic Verification and Market Discipline using Conformal Machine Learning
items.summary: This research proposes using conformal machine learning for algorithmic verification to combat corporate greenwashing and improve market discipline regarding sustainability mandates. It aims to provide objective assessments beyond subjective ESG ratings.

items.title: Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions
items.summary: This paper investigates nearest-neighbor retrieval as a baseline for molecular fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra, finding it can match or outperform deep learning models under certain assumptions. It contributes to method evaluation in cheminformatics.

items.title: Counterfactual Predictions in Scientific Emulators Without Controlled Experiments
items.summary: This research addresses challenges in generating accurate counterfactual predictions with scientific emulators, especially without controlled experiments, by improving how models handle "what-if" queries when inputs are correlated. It focuses on enhancing the reliability of scientific simulations.

items.title: Approximation Property of Dropout Neural Networks: Sobolev Rates and Confidence Bounds
items.summary: This theoretical research studies the approximation properties of dropout neural networks, specifically analyzing Sobolev rates and confidence bounds for ReLU networks. It aims to better understand the network size required for accurate random realizations.

items.title: Overcoming Challenges of Interpretive Structural Modeling with Large Language Models
items.summary: This research explores how Large Language Models can be utilized to overcome traditional challenges in Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM), a multi-criteria decision-making process. It focuses on leveraging LLMs to improve the modeling of causal relationships.

items.title: Effects of interpulse-interval variation on deep-learning classification of bat vocalizations
items.summary: This research investigates the effects of interpulse-interval variation on deep-learning classification of bat vocalizations, specifically evaluating whether this temporal feature aids transformer-based models in species discrimination. It contributes to automated bioacoustics analysis.

items.title: Drive vs. Decay: On the Training Dynamics of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
items.summary: This research develops an early-training stability theory for Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) to understand and mitigate representation collapse. It analyzes the training dynamics of these models to unify existing empirical heuristics.

items.title: From Behavior to Provenance: Attributing Tabular Foundation Models to Synthetic Pretraining Data
items.summary: This research investigates training-data attribution for tabular foundation models, arguing that controlled synthetic pretraining can make causal training influence experimentally testable. It aims to identify which training examples shape model behavior.

items.title: Why Does Adaptive Batching Help LLM Pretraining? A Perspective from Unbounded Variance
items.summary: This research provides a theoretical justification for why adaptive batching helps large language model pretraining, offering a perspective based on unbounded variance in stochastic optimization. It aims to better understand common training practices for LLMs.

items.title: Latent-MOPD: Latent Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Presents Latent-MOPD, a novel representation-level multi-teacher on-policy distillation method for LLMs, which aims to improve training by transferring knowledge from multiple specialist teachers at the hidden state level.

items.title: Hesitation Has a Geometry: Entropy-Trained Hyperbolic Probes for Sparse Activation Steering
items.summary: Proposes using entropy-trained hyperbolic probes to analyze and steer sparse activations in large language models, revealing that LLM reasoning has a hierarchical, tree-like structure best embedded in hyperbolic space.

items.title: Validated Data Onboarding for AI Demand Forecasting on U.S. Building Meter Data: Design, Controlled Evaluation, and a Corrected Negative Result
items.summary: Presents a method for validated data onboarding for AI demand forecasting using U.S. building meter data, addressing challenges of defective real-world data in electric utilities and grid operations.

items.title: Prompted to Discriminate: Generalizing Malicious-Input Probes in the Wild
items.summary: Investigates methods for generalizing malicious-input probes to monitor LLM agents at runtime, using activation probes and LLM-as-judge prompting to detect prompt injection, jailbreaks, and unsafe requests.

items.title: The AI Theorist reveals excitonic structure in $\alpha$-RuCl$_3$
items.summary: Presents "AI Theorist," an AI system that accelerates scientific discovery by revealing the excitonic structure in α-RuCl₃, transforming experimental observations into microscopic understanding.

items.title: Geometry-Aware Time Reparameterization for Flow-Map Distillation
items.summary: Investigates geometry-aware time reparameterization for flow-map distillation, a technique to improve one- and few-step generation by learning finite-time transitions of pretrained generative ODEs more effectively.

items.title: CRISP: A Framework for Clause-Reconstructed Interpretable NeuroSymbolic Propositions
items.summary: Introduces CRISP, a framework that aims to improve the interpretability of deep neural networks by reconstructing last-layer activations into explicit neurosymbolic propositions, making decision evidence auditable.

items.title: A Generative Model of Complex Networks Using Graphons and Neural Inverse Operators
items.summary: Introduces a novel generative model for complex networks that combines graphons with neural inverse operators, aiming to balance interpretability and generative capability.

items.title: A Composable AI-Accelerated Iterative Solver for 3D-IC Thermal Modeling
items.summary: Presents a composable AI-accelerated iterative solver designed to significantly improve the computational efficiency of thermal analysis for 2.5D/3D-IC packages, a process that is traditionally time-consuming.

items.title: Capability Scaling-Down Laws for LLM Compression
items.summary: Investigates capability scaling-down laws for LLM compression, systematically studying how different compression methods and configurations impact model capabilities while reducing inference costs and memory requirements.

items.title: Multi-Fidelity Policy Gradients Stabilize Data-Scarce Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Proposes Multi-Fidelity Policy Gradients to stabilize on-policy reinforcement learning in data-scarce environments, addressing noisy gradient estimates by combining limited high-fidelity data with abundant low-fidelity data.

items.title: Post-Training Quantization of Autoregressive Weather Models
items.summary: This paper introduces post-training quantization for autoregressive weather models, improving their efficiency while maintaining forecast quality comparable to physics-based models for numerical weather prediction.

items.title: BaCP: Backbone Contrastive Pruning for Preserving Representations in Extremely Sparse Neural Networks
items.summary: This paper introduces Backbone Contrastive Pruning (BaCP), a method designed to preserve representational quality in extremely sparse neural networks by regularizing the embedding space during pruning.

items.title: Autoregressive Differentiable Method for Integer Programming
items.summary: This research introduces an autoregressive differentiable method that uses a transformer to solve 0-1 integer programs by predicting the next bit while maintaining feasibility.

items.title: Reward Inflation: A Healthy Stimulus for Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This paper proposes "reward inflation," a method for reinforcement learning that gradually scales reward magnitudes over training to serve as a healthy stimulus for learning.

items.title: Neuron merging via inverse-activation regression for post-training compression of sigmoid neural networks
items.summary: This research proposes neuron merging via inverse-activation regression as a post-training compression method for sigmoid neural networks, aiming for more efficient inference.

items.title: DISSOLVR: An Interpretable and Fast Framework for Aqueous and Organic Solubility Prediction
items.summary: DISSOLVR is presented as an interpretable and fast AI framework for high-fidelity aqueous and organic solubility prediction, crucial for pharmaceutical development and environmental partitioning.

items.title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
items.summary: This research addresses the falsification gap in large language models by framing counterexample generation as constrained witness emission, improving their ability to disprove false theorems using per-theorem symbolic verifiers and reinforcement.

items.title: FinDialogLens: Event Extraction over Multi-Party Dialogue for Missed-Trade Identification in Financial Chatrooms
items.summary: FinDialogLens is presented as a framework for event extraction from multi-party financial chatroom dialogues, specifically designed to identify missed trades for sales-and-trading professionals.

items.title: From Retrieval to Typed Decisions: Calibrated System One Models from Biomedical Sentence Encoders
items.summary: This research investigates building calibrated System One models for typed decisions from biomedical sentence encoders, introducing SBERT2S1, which converts Sentence-Transformers for this purpose.

items.title: A generative-informed neuro-symbolic framework for syntactic ambiguity resolution: Evidence from Arabic DPs
items.summary: This study proposes a generative-informed neuro-symbolic framework to resolve syntactic ambiguity in Arabic NLP, particularly for morphologically rich nominal constructions.

items.title: Clinical Concept Centers in LLMs
items.summary: This study investigates 'Clinical Concept Centers' within the latent space of LLMs used in clinical settings, using mechanistic interpretability to explore model reliability beyond surface-level output.

items.title: How Robust Is Multimodal Claim Verification to LLM Rewriting?
items.summary: This paper investigates the robustness of multimodal claim verification systems when LLMs introduce stylistic changes into text, exploring how these shifts affect model decisions on scientific tasks.

items.title: ConvoDrift: A Multi-Turn Conversational Dataset for Modeling Stylistic Tone Evolution
items.summary: ConvoDrift is introduced as a multi-turn conversational dataset designed to model the evolution of linguistic style, capturing dynamic shifts in user preferences throughout interactions.

items.title: Output Language Confusion under Multilingual Prompt Contamination
items.summary: This paper examines 'Output Language Confusion' in multilingual LLMs when exposed to prompt contamination, highlighting challenges for factual benchmarks in real-world multilingual deployments.

items.title: Enhancing Biomedical Named Entity Recognition via Multiple Programming Languages Instruction Tuning and Ensemble Method
items.summary: A new method combining Multiple Programming Languages Instruction Tuning and an Ensemble Method is proposed to enhance Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (BioNER) using large language models.

items.title: OmniConfess: Eliciting Token Confessions to Mitigate Omni-Modal Hallucination
items.summary: OmniConfess is a method proposed to mitigate hallucination in omni-modal large language models by eliciting token confessions during inference. It aims to reveal which evidence sustains a generated commitment in multimodal outputs.

items.title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: This research explores recursive self-improvement in unified multimodal models, enabling them to generate their own training data to enhance both text and image understanding and generation capabilities. It proposes a cross-capability self-improvement approach.

items.title: HyperThink: Text-to-Parameter Hypernetworks for Efficient Reasoning
items.summary: HyperThink introduces a text-to-parameter hypernetwork approach designed to improve the efficiency of long-form reasoning in large language models. It aims to reduce inference-time overhead associated with sequential decoding for complex reasoning tasks.

items.title: The Geometry of Knowledge Accessibility in Large Language Models
items.summary: This study investigates the concept of knowledge accessibility in large language models, exploring whether the knowledge needed for a query can be reliably recalled. It finds that knowledge accessibility has a simple geometric structure within the models.

items.title: HARPO: Hallucination-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Faithful and Creative Language Generation
items.summary: HARPO is a reinforcement learning framework designed to address hallucination in large language models by jointly optimizing for faithfulness and creativity in language generation. It aims to improve the reliability of LLMs in knowledge-intensive tasks.

items.title: Unmasking Propaganda: A Comparative Analysis of Masked and Causal Language Models
items.summary: This research conducts a comparative analysis of masked and causal language models for propaganda detection in natural language processing. It aims to identify specific propaganda techniques, addressing the challenge of their subtle nature in text.

items.title: An automated pipeline for standardised speech-unit annotation in spontaneous dialogue
items.summary: This paper presents an automated pipeline for standardized speech-unit annotation in spontaneous dialogue, designed to reliably identify interactional units and their temporal boundaries. It helps distinguish conversational turns from listener feedback and within-turn pauses.

items.title: Emergent Structure in the Marginal Attention Space of Language Models
items.summary: This study examines the emergent structure within the marginal attention space of language models, analyzing how internal mechanics like attention behave across independently trained models. It investigates the structure of post-softmax attention weights.

items.title: Ontological Instability and Statistical Amplification: The Paradox of "Humanizing" LLM-Generated Text
items.summary: This research analyzes the decisions of supervised AI-text detectors, investigating "ontological instability" when "humanizing" LLM-generated text and the statistical amplification that occurs. It uses a RoBERTa-based detector to study its behavior under perturbations.

items.title: Building Interpretable Feature Representations for Resume-Vacancy Matching by Distilling Production LLM Signals
items.summary: This paper proposes a two-part method for building interpretable feature representations for resume-vacancy matching in recruitment, by distilling signals from production LLMs. The goal is to provide recruiters with clear, actionable matching dimensions.

items.title: Investigating the Role of Reasoning-Language Alignment in Monolingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: This research investigates the role of reasoning-language alignment in monolingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for large language models. It examines how the language used for reasoning affects model accuracy and performance.

items.title: Predicting Steering Vectors and Adapter Weights for Few-Shot Author-Style Transfer
items.summary: This paper proposes a method for predicting steering vectors and adapter weights to achieve few-shot author-style transfer in large language models. It addresses the challenge of adapting LLMs to individual author styles, particularly in scientific writing.

items.title: Hindsight-Guided Rationale Distillation for Rare Disease Diagnosis
items.summary: This research explores hindsight-guided rationale distillation for rare disease diagnosis, where a smaller student model is fine-tuned on chain-of-thought traces from a larger teacher model. It investigates improving diagnostic accuracy for challenging medical tasks.

items.title: Shrome at Touch\'e: Soft-Vote Ensembling and Counter-Causal Augmentation for Causality Extraction
items.summary: This paper introduces a system for causality extraction, focusing on counter-causal claims in news sentences. It uses soft-vote ensembling and counter-causal augmentation to improve accuracy.

items.title: Single-Pass Uncertainty Heads for Claim-Level Hallucination Detection in Persian Medical Language Models
items.summary: This research introduces single-pass uncertainty heads for efficient claim-level hallucination detection in Persian medical language models. It adapts the LLM Uncertainty Head framework to improve reliability in specialized language models.

items.title: Structured Composition of Verifiable Atomic Insights for Table-to-Report Generation
items.summary: This paper proposes a method for structured composition of verifiable atomic insights to enable automatic table-to-report generation. It addresses the challenge of systematically discovering composite insights from relational tables for automated data science.

items.title: Author Representation Strategies for Zero-Shot Authorship Attribution: A Comparative Study of LLM-Based and Embedding-Based Approaches
items.summary: This study investigates author representation strategies for zero-shot authorship attribution by comparing LLM-based and embedding-based approaches. It evaluates their effectiveness in capturing fine-grained stylistic characteristics without task-specific supervision.

items.title: EviDent-CBCT: Evidence-Bottlenecked Report Generation from Dental CBCT under Non-Exhaustive Report Supervision
items.summary: This research introduces EviDent-CBCT, a method for evidence-bottlenecked report generation from dental CBCT scans under non-exhaustive supervision. It addresses the challenges of generating comprehensive reports from limited clinical data.

items.title: Octrees as an Explicit 3D Language
items.summary: This research explores octrees as an explicit 3D language for large language models, addressing limitations in current 3D LLMs that compress shapes into latent codebook indices or coordinate text. It aims to preserve spatial structure for 3D modality acquisition.

items.title: An AI-Based Multi-Stage Approach for Androgenetic Alopecia Assessment from Low-Magnification Scalp Images
items.summary: This paper presents an AI-based multi-stage approach and clinical decision-support framework for assessing androgenetic alopecia from low-magnification scalp images. It combines follicular unit localization and ordinal visible-shaft analysis.

items.title: DeepStratNet: A Context-Aware Coordinate Regression Framework for Seismic Horizon Tracking under Sparse Labels
items.summary: This paper introduces DeepStratNet, a context-aware coordinate regression framework for automatic seismic horizon tracking under sparse labels. It aims to improve 3D seismic interpretation by addressing limitations of dense semantic segmentation.

items.title: Found but Not Read: When Extracted Text Closes the Retrieval-Reading Gap in Document Vision-Language Models
items.summary: This paper investigates the 'retrieval-reading gap' in document Vision-Language Models, where models find relevant information but fail to use it, and proposes a paired protocol to isolate this issue.

items.title: Revealing Epistemic Uncertainty in MLLMs via Causal-Invariant Masking
items.summary: This research introduces Causal-Invariant Masking as a method to reveal epistemic uncertainty in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), addressing the problem of hallucinations for more reliable deployment.

items.title: Kinematics-Induced Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation with Subject-Level Privacy
items.summary: This research presents a unified framework for Kinematics-Induced Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation that addresses subject-level privacy risks, which are often overlooked in current models trained on correlated observations.

items.title: BeeWhere: Segmenting Bumble Bee Colonies to Quantify Behavioral Effects
items.summary: BeeWhere uses segmentation techniques to quantify individual and colony-level behavior in bumble bee colonies, aiming to provide scalable measurement in dense, occluded nest environments for ecological research.

items.title: CalCErt: Bin-wise Certification of Confidence Calibration in Medical Image Classification
items.summary: CalCErt introduces a bin-wise certification method for confidence calibration in medical image classification, aiming to provide guarantees on how neural networks behave under adversarial perturbations.

items.title: Does Physics Live in the Activations? Localizing Physical Quantities in Video Diffusion Models
items.summary: This research investigates whether video diffusion models internalize physical principles by localizing physical quantities within their activations, exploring their capacity for physical reasoning beyond mere reproduction.

items.title: Bridging Research and Practice: A Systematic Evaluation of Generalist and Dermatology-Specific Models in Clinical Skin Lesion Classification
items.summary: This paper presents a systematic evaluation of generalist and dermatology-specific machine learning models for clinical skin lesion classification, bridging the gap between research and practical application in the field.

items.title: On Representational Alignment among Embodied Agents
items.summary: Investigates the necessary distinctions that must be resolved for coherence among embodied agents, given their heterogeneous, asynchronous, and observer-relative representations of shared physical processes.

items.title: HexVIO: Towards All-Day Stereo-Inertial Tracking Through Commodity DSPs
items.summary: Presents HexVIO, a visual-inertial odometry (VIO) system that enables all-day stereo-inertial tracking through commodity DSPs, providing efficient and accurate localization for various devices.

items.summary: This paper proposes AVL-JEPA, a method to prevent causal dynamics information collapse in Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture world models, focusing on architectural improvements for AI models.
