items.title: Unitree Robotics' Wang Xingxing: Embodied Intelligence Tipping Point Could Arrive Within One to Two Years - BigGo Finance
items.summary: Unitree Robotics' Wang Xingxing predicts that a tipping point for embodied intelligence in robotics could be reached within one to two years.

items.title: AlphaNIST: Emergent Assembly Skills from Binary Task Rewards
items.summary: This research introduces 'AlphaNIST,' a system that demonstrates emergent assembly skills in robotic manipulation using binary task rewards, addressing the challenging NIST Assembly Task Board #1 benchmark.

items.title: PanTact: Teaching Whole-Body Dexterity with a Wearable Contact Interface
items.summary: PanTact is a system designed to teach humanoid robots whole-body dexterity by utilizing a wearable contact interface, extending manipulation capabilities beyond just the hands.

items.title: CASTER: Formalizing Zero-Shot Manipulation from Synthetic Videos as Constrained Optimization
items.summary: CASTER is a method for formalizing zero-shot manipulation for robots from synthetic videos, using video generation models to create task demonstrations and frame the learning as constrained optimization.

items.title: Graph-Based Heuristics for Minimum Constraint Removal in Cluttered Robot Motion Planning
items.summary: This research explores graph-based heuristics for Minimum Constraint Removal (MCR) in cluttered robot motion planning, enabling humanoid and service robots to navigate environments where obstacles might need to be temporarily moved.

items.title: Image-Based Path-Planning for Navigation of Soft-Growing Robots in the Spinal Sub-Arachnoid Space
items.summary: This research investigates image-based path-planning algorithms for soft-growing robots, enabling their navigation within the spinal sub-arachnoid space for targeted minimally invasive medical procedures.

items.title: Selectively Actuated Fiberbots for High-precision Minimally Invasive Surgery
items.summary: This paper presents electrothermally actuated fiberbots designed for high-precision minimally invasive surgery, addressing challenges in distal manipulation for MIS procedures.

items.title: PriMoRetarget: Humanoid Motion Transfer Through Prioritized Motion Retargeting
items.summary: PriMoRetarget proposes a method for transferring human motion data to humanoid robots, focusing on prioritizing motion retargeting for complex interactions with multiple characters and objects.

items.title: Non-Prehensile Multi-Object Placement with Mobile Robots via Diffusion-Based Trajectory Planning
items.summary: This research explores non-prehensile multi-object placement with mobile robots, using diffusion-based trajectory planning to achieve precision placement beyond coarse goal regions.

items.title: FallGown: A Soft Pneumatic Wearable Device for Fall Prevention
items.summary: FallGown is a soft pneumatic wearable device designed for fall prevention in older adults, functioning as an active support similar to exoskeletons or robotic assistance.

items.title: StereoEngine: Scaling Stereo Bimanual Robot Data without Stereo Cameras
items.summary: StereoEngine proposes a method to scale stereo bimanual robot data for robotic manipulation, generating large-scale stereo datasets without requiring stereo cameras.

items.title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
items.summary: Reflex introduces a system for visually grounded reactive control of humanoids, enabling them to anticipate and respond reflexively with their whole body to moving targets in real-time.

items.title: Multimodal Image-based Robotic Assistance and Guidance Environment (MIRAGE): A Novel Unified Framework for Surgical Navigation and Visualization
items.summary: MIRAGE presents a novel unified framework for multimodal image-guided robotic surgery, integrating stereovision scene reconstruction and augmented reality for real-time navigation and visualization.

items.title: Tactile Sensing-based Secure and Gentle Grasping of Unknown Objects
items.summary: This paper proposes a tactile sensing-based approach for secure and gentle grasping of unknown objects in robotic manipulation, ensuring both firm grip and object integrity.

items.title: VLMs are Native Action Models: Unleashing the Manipulation Capabilities of VLMs with Explicit Action-Space Grounding
items.summary: This work explores leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as native action models for robotic manipulation by explicitly grounding them in the action space.

items.title: Evidence-Guided Counterfactual Learning for Long-Tailed Robotic Policies
items.summary: This research presents evidence-guided counterfactual learning to address long-tailed task distributions in robotic policies, improving performance on less common tasks in robot demonstration datasets.

items.title: TAME-Nav: Temporal Asymmetric Mixture-of-Experts Distillation for Agile and Versatile Robot Navigation
items.summary: TAME-Nav introduces a Temporal Asymmetric Mixture-of-Experts Distillation method for agile and versatile robot navigation, enabling embodied robots to adapt to diverse and complex scenarios.

items.title: LeapBot-JAC: Joint Action Chains for World Action Models
items.summary: LeapBot-JAC proposes Joint Action Chains for World Action Models, a method for organizing action-chunking policies to support execution and efficient replanning for robot control.

items.title: Adaptive Whole-Body MPC with Optimal Posture Planning for Humanoid Robots under Unknown Payloads
items.summary: This paper proposes an adaptive whole-body control architecture for humanoid robots to maintain balance and stability during lifting and material-handling tasks, even with unknown and varying payloads.

items.title: VICAR: Video Imitation with Contact-Aware Retargeting for Humanoid Interactive Skills
items.summary: This research presents VICAR, a system for humanoid loco-manipulation that uses third-person human videos to extract noisy motion, object trajectories, and contacts for imitation learning.

items.title: Belief-Overlap Partial Inversion: Object-Centric Flow Replanning for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: This work introduces an object-centric framework for humanoids to learn how unfamiliar objects move through exploratory pushes, using the response to guide subsequent motion, specifically for pushing carts with unknown properties.

items.title: Human2Dex: Dexterous Robot Learning from Wrist-Centric Human Demonstrations
items.summary: This research investigates using a shared corpus of natural human demonstrations as a reusable data interface for different dexterous robot hands, aiming to reduce the need for task-specific data acquisition.

items.title: PATACON: GPU-Parallel Tangent-Bundle RRT-Connect for Constrained Motion Planning
items.summary: This research introduces PATACON, a GPU-parallel algorithm for fast whole-body motion planning for humanoid robots, enabling continuous replanning in dynamic environments while satisfying collision avoidance and kinematic constraints.

items.title: Evo-RL: Iterative Robot Reinforcement Learning from Selective Experience
items.summary: This research presents Evo-RL, an iterative reinforcement learning method for robots that improves policies by selectively using experience from human corrections and autonomous rollouts, focusing on valuable trajectories.

items.title: PartiGen: Part-Aware Representations for Language-Conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
items.summary: This paper introduces PartiGen, a part-aware latent diffusion framework that integrates anatomical structure for language-conditioned humanoid motion generation, allowing for coordinated body parts and suitable robot execution references.

items.title: EndoRSI: Physical-Evidence-Driven Recursive Improvement of Endoscopic Robot Policies
items.summary: This research presents EndoRSI, a human-governed system for physical-evidence-driven recursive improvement of endoscopic robot policies, aiming to automate the revision of controllers based on experimental failures.

items.title: Robot-WATCHDOG : failure detection through object-centric graph representation
items.summary: This paper introduces Robot-WATCHDOG, a method for reliable real-time failure detection in learned robotic policies using object-centric graph representations, designed to work from nominal demonstrations.

items.title: RESCUE: Is This Alarm Worth Acting On? Counterfactual Evaluation of VLA Runtime Monitors
items.summary: This paper introduces RESCUE, a counterfactual evaluation method for runtime failure monitors in robot policies, assessing whether alarms are timely enough for recovery or if interventions disrupt otherwise successful executions.

items.title: Beyond Successful Robot Demonstrations: Learning from Human Interactions and Modeling Failure Dynamics
items.summary: This work explores improving generalist robotic intelligence by learning from human interactions and modeling failure dynamics, moving beyond just successful robot demonstrations through large-scale egocentric video datasets.

items.title: ATHLETE: Learning Reactive Humanoid Tennis via Trajectory-Guided Motion Matching
items.summary: This research presents ATHLETE, a method for learning reactive humanoid tennis skills using trajectory-guided motion matching to enable whole-body coordination under rapidly changing ball dynamics.

items.title: RARA: Robust Policy Fine-Tuning through Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This paper introduces RARA, a method for robust policy fine-tuning in robotic manipulation that uses retrieval-anchored representation alignment to adapt pre-trained robot policies, such as VLA models, to new tasks with few demonstrations.

items.title: Unitree G1 humanoid robot attends parade of Ljubljana Wind Orchestra in Slovenia - Xinhua
items.summary: A Unitree G1 humanoid robot participated in a parade of the Ljubljana Wind Orchestra in Slovenia, showcasing its mobility in a public demonstration.

items.title: BeingBeyond's Being-M0.7 Uses 10,000 Hours of Human Video to Teach Humanoids to Walk and Grasp
items.summary: BeingBeyond's Being-M0.7 model uses 10,000 hours of human video to train humanoids in walking and grasping, achieving strong performance in simulation and on a Unitree G1 robot.

items.title: JAKA Robotics Debuts Kargo50 Heavy-Duty Wheeled Humanoid and Zu50 Cobot at Shanghai Industry Fair
items.summary: JAKA Robotics is introducing the Kargo50, a heavy-duty wheeled humanoid for factory use, and the Zu50, a 50 kg collaborative robot arm, at the Shanghai Industry Fair.

items.title: Ubtech Robotics Balances Factory Trials and Incentive-Plan Buying as JPMorgan Cuts Rating - ad-hoc-news.de
items.summary: Ubtech Robotics is balancing factory trials of its physical robots with incentive-plan buying, as JPMorgan issues a rating cut for the company.

items.title: Will ‘boring’ robots win in the real world? Why robotic form should follow workflow
items.summary: The article argues that for physical AI robots to achieve sustained commercial success in the real world, their design and form should prioritize workflow and practical application over novelty.

items.title: Ubtech Robotics Inks C&D Distribution Venture as FAW-Volkswagen Pilot Takes Shape - ad-hoc-news.de
items.summary: Ubtech Robotics has entered into a C&D distribution venture and is progressing with a pilot project alongside FAW-Volkswagen, focusing on the deployment of its physical robots.

items.title: Westlake Robotics' WR1 Brain Has Two Humanoids Fold Trousers With Dexterous Hands
items.summary: Westlake Robotics' WR1 general brain enables two humanoid robots to demonstrate dexterous manipulation by folding trousers and completing household chores.

items.title: Building AI for Reliable Execution: Lessons From Industrial Robotics
items.summary: This article details the development of AI for reliable execution in industrial robotics, specifically how Standard Bots' AI stack enables pretrained models to learn factory tasks from demonstrations and real-world deployments.

items.title: Striding AI Unveils H1 and C1 Robots for 24/7 Convenience Stores, Targets 2027 Service Launch
items.summary: Striding AI has unveiled humanoid H1 and wheeled-arm C1 robots designed for 24/7 convenience stores, demonstrating physical robots for commercial deployment.

items.title: The Reality and Illusion of Physical AI: Unlocking Real-World Potential vs. Separating Hype from Truth - eu.36kr.com
items.summary: The article explores the actual potential of physical AI, distinguishing it from hype, and discussing its real-world applications.

items.title: The man behind the boom in Chinese humanoid robots. - Vietnam.vn
items.summary: The article profiles a key figure contributing to the surge in Chinese humanoid robot development.

items.title: Inside the ‘robot gyms’ training machines for the real world
items.summary: Developers are using 'robot gyms' to train physical AI systems by placing cameras in real-world environments like homes and factories to gather training data.

items.title: Why humanoid robot demos still fail the generalization test
items.summary: Humanoid robot demonstrations continue to struggle with generalization, failing to perform reliably in diverse real-world scenarios. The article discusses how improved data and human judgment could help these robots achieve better real-world performance.

items.title: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen Expand Robot Testing Into Logistics - Yahoo Tech
items.summary: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen are expanding their collaboration to test robots in logistics operations.

items.title: Boston Dynamics gives more insight into its redesigned humanoid hand
items.summary: Boston Dynamics provides details on the redesigned hand for its Atlas humanoid robot, explaining its new capabilities to director Alberto Rodriguez.

items.title: Danu Robotics’ fight to build a better recycling robot
items.summary: Danu Robotics is working on developing an improved recycling robot designed to sort recyclable waste more efficiently. The article highlights efforts to advance AI-powered physical robots for waste management.

items.title: Apart from being unable to make phone calls, humanoid robots are becoming more and more like mobile phones. - eu.36kr.com
items.summary: Humanoid robots are evolving to become increasingly similar to mobile phones in functionality, except for making phone calls.

items.title: UBTECH and Volkswagen team up to test humanoid robots in car factories - Interesting Engineering
items.summary: UBTECH is partnering with Volkswagen to test humanoid robots for deployment in car manufacturing factories.

items.title: KingKong Technology Open-Sources Jumper, a 22-DoF Crab Robot That Jumps Over 400 mm
items.summary: KingKong Technology has open-sourced the simulation, reinforcement learning, and deployment toolchain for Jumper, its 1.8 kg, 22-DoF crab robot that can jump over 400 mm.

items.title: Continuous Ground-Truth Construction and a Recovery Policy for Air--Water Robotic Tracking
items.summary: This paper addresses challenges in visual tracking for robotics across the air-water interface, proposing methods for continuous ground-truth construction and a recovery policy for robust tracking.

items.title: Teaching a Robot Dog New Tricks: Diverse Quadruped Skills via Combined Reinforcement and Imitation Learning with Adversarial Task Selection
items.summary: Explores teaching robot dogs diverse skills, such as locomotion, digging, and surveying, using a combination of reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and adversarial task selection to create robust policies.

items.title: TacHair: Tactile Contact-Distribution Guided Online Correction for Robotic Hair Stroking and Perception
items.summary: Introduces TacHair, a method for robotic hair stroking and perception that uses tactile contact-distribution guided online correction, enhancing robots' physical interaction capabilities for grooming and product evaluation.

items.title: TAPNAV: Humanoid Navigation through Tactile Active Perception
items.summary: Introduces TAPNAV, a tactile active-perception framework enabling humanoid robots to navigate towards a goal in vision-denied environments by actively probing their surroundings.

items.title: Diagnosing and Recovering from Observation-Space Shift at Long-Horizon Skill Seams
items.summary: This paper addresses performance degradation in long-horizon robotic manipulation when chaining independently trained skills, proposing methods to diagnose and recover from observation-space shift.

items.title: Skill-SLM: Agent Skill-driven Small Language Models for Reliable Robot Operation
items.summary: This work introduces Skill-SLM, an agent skill-driven small language model approach designed to improve reliable robot operation and intelligent decision-making by addressing challenges in dataset construction.

items.title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
items.summary: This research introduces the Latent Action-Conditioned Robot World Model (LAC-WM) to address challenges in building robot world models that generalize across diverse robot embodiments by using a unified latent action space.

items.title: Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design for Sim-to-Real System Identification
items.summary: This paper proposes an informationally decoupled trajectory design method for sim-to-real system identification, aiming to improve transfer by more accurately estimating physical parameters through simulator tuning.

items.title: When Listening Becomes Easier: Scrubbing Visual Cues for Shortcut-Free VLAs
items.summary: This research investigates shortcut learning in robot learning and proposes methods to improve Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by scrubbing visual cues from datasets, leading to more robust policies for robots.

items.title: Higher-Order Morphology Priors for Quadruped Reinforcement Learning Under Actuator Degradation
items.summary: This paper explores the use of higher-order morphology priors in reinforcement learning to improve quadruped locomotion and generalization, particularly when facing actuator degradation.

items.title: ActiveReg: Information-Driven Active Regional Probing for Partial-to-Full Bone Registration
items.summary: This paper presents ActiveReg, a method for information-driven active regional probing to improve partial-to-full bone registration, essential for orthopedic surgical navigation and robotic assistance.

items.title: A Reconfigurable Fabric Based Pneumatic Actuator with Button Fastened Constraint Modules for Multi Mode Actuation
items.summary: This paper introduces a reconfigurable fabric-based pneumatic actuator that uses button-fastened constraint modules to enable multi-mode actuation, addressing the difficulty of post-fabrication reconfiguration in soft robotics.

items.title: Towards Path-Creative Navigation: Robot Navigation through Embodied Interaction
items.summary: This research explores "path-creative navigation" for robots, where they can autonomously navigate cluttered environments by interacting with and reconfiguring objects, rather than just finding paths in static free space.

items.title: FOCUS: From Privileged States to RGB-D with Controlled Modality Switching and Representation Alignment
items.summary: This paper introduces FOCUS, a method for vision-based reinforcement learning in robotic manipulation that uses controlled modality switching and representation alignment to bridge the sim-to-real gap from privileged states to RGB-D observations.

items.title: Distributed Relative Localization Based on Ultra-WideBand and LiDAR for Multi-robot with Limited Communication
items.summary: This paper proposes a distributed relative localization method for multi-robot systems, leveraging Ultra-WideBand (UWB) and LiDAR data with limited communication to enable collaborative task performance in GPS-denied environments.

items.title: PMTRM: Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module for Embodied Policy Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces PMTRM (Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module) to improve embodied policy learning in robotic manipulation by addressing issues of similar local observations during repeated motions.

items.title: OmniDex: Scaling Dexterous Hand Grasping to Diverse Cluttered Scenes
items.summary: This paper presents OmniDex, a framework for scaling dexterous hand grasping to diverse cluttered scenes by leveraging simulation to generate the massive data required for training robust embodied AI models.

items.title: Demonstrating Arena 5.0: A Photorealistic ROS2 Simulation Framework for Developing and Benchmarking Social Navigation
items.summary: This paper introduces Arena 5.0, a photorealistic ROS2 simulation framework integrating NVIDIA Isaac Gym, designed for developing and benchmarking robotics social navigation capabilities.

items.title: SafeInferCom: Safe Inference-Time Compute via Verifier-Guided Mid-Generation Intervention for Robotic Task Planning
items.summary: This paper introduces SafeInferCom, a method that uses verifier-guided mid-generation intervention to ensure safe inference-time computation for Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) applied to robotic task planning.

items.title: SimVLA: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Learning for Mobile Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces SimVLA, a framework for zero-shot sim-to-real Vision-Language-Action (VLA) learning aimed at advancing mobile manipulation capabilities in robotics by leveraging scalable simulation.

items.title: Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
items.summary: This paper introduces Being-M0.7, a Latent World-Action Model designed to enable complex loco-manipulation capabilities in humanoid robots by learning from diverse human video and motion datasets.

items.title: Distributed Relative Localization for Homogeneous Multi-Robot Systems through UWB Ranging and Limited Communications
items.summary: This research presents a method for distributed relative localization in homogeneous multi-robot systems, utilizing Ultra-WideBand (UWB) ranging and limited communications to improve accuracy for collaborative tasks.

items.title: USDCraft: Geometrically Grounded Programmatic Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation
items.summary: This research introduces USDCraft, a method for programmatically modeling articulated 3D assets to improve real-to-simulation transfer for robot manipulation tasks.

items.title: WAM-Cache: Staleness-Bounded KV Reuse for Efficient World Action Models
items.summary: WAM-Cache proposes a method for efficient key-value pair reuse to optimize World Action Models (WAMs) used in generalist robot manipulation for closed-loop control.

items.title: Rewiring Semantics, Dynamics, and Control: A Simple yet Effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer
items.summary: This paper presents an action-centric tri-stream transformer that improves Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for complex robotic manipulation by incorporating physical dynamics.

items.title: Experience-Guided Initiation Search for Learned Skills in Skill Composition
items.summary: This work focuses on an experience-guided search method to identify reliable initiation configurations for deploying learned robotic skills in new environments.

items.title: RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes
items.summary: RoboAware introduces a system for embodied coding agents to learn how to coordinate modular robot skills by predicting successful policy families based on counterfactual outcomes.

items.title: DAMP: Humanoid Locomotion via Denoised Belief Learning and Adversarial Motion Priors
items.summary: DAMP is a reinforcement learning framework designed to achieve stable locomotion for humanoid robots across complex terrains using denoised belief learning and adversarial motion priors.

items.title: WARP-VLA: Wrist-Camera Adaptation for View-Robust Policy Execution in Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: WARP-VLA addresses the sensitivity of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in robotic manipulation to camera configuration changes, specifically for wrist-camera adaptation.

items.title: RAGNAROK: Radar-Aided Gravity-Normalized Alignment for Robust Open Keyframe-based Radar-Visual-Kinematic-Inertial SLAM
items.summary: RAGNAROK presents a robust radar-aided SLAM system for legged robots to improve state estimation and navigation in unstructured environments.

items.title: Learning Language-Conditioned Traversability Representations for Adaptive Visual Navigation
items.summary: This research explores learning language-conditioned traversability representations to enable adaptive visual navigation for robots based on environmental conditions and user preferences.

items.title: Neural Networks for Temporal Pattern Recognition and Dynamic Arm Gesture Speed Estimation for Robot Control
items.summary: This paper benchmarks neural networks for recognizing temporal patterns and estimating arm gesture speeds to enable intelligent robotic systems to interact with humans.

items.title: YOCO: You Only Calibrate Once! Fast Mocap Calibration for Dexterous Teleoperation
items.summary: YOCO introduces a fast motion capture calibration method to improve human-hand state estimation and data quality for dexterous robot teleoperation.

items.title: From Solo to Ensemble: A Hierarchical Framework for Composable Multi-Agent Human-Object Interaction
items.summary: This work presents a hierarchical framework for composable multi-agent human-object interaction, extending single-agent manipulation skills to cooperative robotic tasks.

items.title: UltraLight Luma: A Novel Edge-Deployable Perception Network for Crop-Row Segmentation in Agricultural Robotics
items.summary: UltraLight Luma proposes a novel, edge-deployable perception network for crop-row segmentation, enabling efficient autonomous navigation for agricultural robots.

items.title: PathTime-VLA: Path-Time Decoupling for Factorized Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.summary: PathTime-VLA introduces a method to decouple path and time in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, improving post-training adaptation for robotic execution from teleoperation.

items.title: STAG: A Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph Representation from Grid-Based Costmaps for Robotic Navigation
items.summary: STAG develops a sparse traversability-aware graph representation from grid-based costmaps to enable efficient global planning for autonomous robotic navigation in large, unstructured environments.

items.title: TACROSS: An Efficient and Low-Cost Scalable Human Touch System Across Heterogeneous Tactile Sensors for Dexterous Robot Learning
items.summary: TACROSS proposes an efficient and low-cost human touch system to scale the collection of tactile demonstrations for dexterous robot learning using heterogeneous sensors.

items.title: Tell Robot What Not to Do: A Negation Understanding Perspective
items.summary: This research investigates how to enable robots to understand negative constraints in natural language instructions for human-robot interaction.

items.title: Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning for Temporally Robust Robot Manipulation
items.summary: This research explores how generated videos can guide robot manipulation, highlighting the importance of temporal alignment for robust performance.

items.title: CAPABLE: Capability-Aware Policy Adaptation via Behavioral Latent Encoding
items.summary: This research introduces CAPABLE, a method for Vision-Language-Action policies to adapt to robot embodiment faults, improving fault recovery without extensive retraining.

items.title: REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models
items.summary: This research proposes REACT, a method using VLA models for reactive robot control that balances smooth execution with improved reactivity for robotic motion.

items.title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
items.summary: This paper introduces a Humanoid World Action Model that improves action generation for humanoid robots by incorporating joint state-action generation and future visual prediction.

items.title: Traceable World State: A Provenance-Aware State Representation and Deterministic Replay Framework for Robotic Systems
items.summary: This research proposes a provenance-aware state representation and deterministic replay framework for robotic systems to maintain a traceable world state from observations.

items.title: SkillWeave: Weaving Heterogeneous Demonstrations into Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills
items.summary: This research introduces SkillWeave, a framework that enables robots to learn long-horizon, dexterous manipulation skills by weaving together heterogeneous demonstrations.

items.title: Humanoid Robot Competition Shifts to "Getting Work Done" — Can Crowdsourced Data Platforms Crack the Deployment Challenge? - BigGo Finance
items.summary: A humanoid robot competition is shifting focus towards practical task execution, exploring whether crowdsourced data platforms can address deployment challenges.

items.title: Simplexity Robotics Trains One Robot to Tend Two CNC Lathes With 600 Real Trajectories
items.summary: Simplexity Robotics demonstrated a single robot successfully tending two CNC lathes and inserting parts with high precision after being trained on 600 real trajectories.

items.title: Jabil discusses the pace of humanoid robot development and production
items.summary: Jabil, a company collaborating with robot developers like Apptronik, offers insights into the progress of humanoid robot development and production.

items.title: Humanoid robots compete in martial arts in Singapore in two weight classes. - Vietnam.vn
items.summary: Humanoid robots are competing in martial arts in Singapore, participating in two distinct weight classes.

items.title: UBTECH to Build First Overseas Robot Production Base in Almaty - Gasgoo
items.summary: UBTECH, a robotics company, plans to establish its first overseas robot production base in Almaty, Kazakhstan.

items.title: The Download: AI roadblocks for humanoids and portable rubber dams
items.summary: This article discusses the current challenges and significant hype surrounding humanoid robots, indicating that AI breakthroughs in this field may not immediately impact daily life.

items.title: AI breakthroughs in robotics won’t change your life any time soon
items.summary: This article, a collaboration between MIT Technology Review and Aventine, discusses that despite recent AI breakthroughs in robotics, their impact on daily life is not imminent, referencing humanoid robots.

items.title: Galbot and Tsinghua's LATENT Wins an IROS Award for a Humanoid Tennis Forehand
items.summary: The LATENT system, developed by Galbot, Tsinghua, and collaborators, won an IROS award for demonstrating a Unitree G1 humanoid robot successfully returning tennis forehands.

items.title: UBTECH, FAW-Volkswagen partner on humanoid robots for logistics and smart manufacturing - Gasgoo
items.summary: UBTECH has partnered with FAW-Volkswagen to deploy humanoid robots for logistics and smart manufacturing applications.

items.title: GUARD: Geometric Uncertainty-Aware Point Cloud Denoising and Segmentation for Robotic Hard Disk Drive Disassembly
items.summary: Introduces GUARD, a geometric uncertainty-aware method for point cloud denoising and segmentation, enabling reliable part-level representation for robotic hard disk drive disassembly.

items.title: SAFE: Unified Slip and Fracture Detection with Low-Cost Acoustic Sensing in Robotic Grasping
items.summary: This paper presents SAFE, a low-cost acoustic sensing approach for robots to detect slip and fracture when grasping fragile objects, especially when material properties are unknown.

items.title: Context-Aware Adaptive Pesticide Spraying for Agricultural Robots under Changing Weather and Terrain Using Vision-Language Models
items.summary: This research focuses on optimizing precision pesticide spraying for agricultural robots by enabling them to adapt to changing environmental conditions using vision-language models.

items.title: Autonomous Droplet Navigation via Model-Based Reinforcement Learning: Zero-Shot Transfer and Emergent Dynamics
items.summary: This research explores autonomous droplet transport within self-driving laboratories using model-based reinforcement learning, focusing on zero-shot transfer and emergent dynamics for physical manipulation of soft matter.

items.title: HULK: Learning Whole-Body Forceful Loco-Manipulation for Humanoids
items.summary: This paper introduces HULK, a whole-body control framework enabling humanoids to perform forceful loco-manipulation of large, heavy objects, addressing challenges in balance and command tracking.

items.title: MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Video-Driven Humanoid Motion Tracking
items.summary: MimicX is a policy-in-the-loop framework that refines training supervision for video-driven humanoid motion tracking by using execution failures to identify where changes are needed.

items.title: Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data
items.summary: Workhorse enables humanoid robots to learn robust whole-body loco-manipulation from human demonstrations, utilizing a visual planner and reinforcement learning to predict poses for interaction with the environment.

items.title: FlashNeRD: Performance-First Contact-Rich Neural Robot Dynamics
items.summary: FlashNeRD is a neural robot dynamics model that aims for faster, differentiable, and adaptable robot simulation by replacing numerical dynamics with learned models while keeping collision detection analytical.

items.title: World Models Dream of Success: Diagnosing and Repairing Failure Insensitivity in Robot World Models
items.summary: This research diagnoses and addresses the issue of weak sensitivity to action changes and success/failure in robot world models, which are crucial for policy evaluation, planning, and synthetic data generation.

items.title: Beyond Reconstruction: What Matters in Action Tokenization for Robot Policies?
items.summary: This paper investigates effective action tokenization for autoregressive action-token robot policies, such as vision-language-action models, aiming to translate discrete token sequences into precise continuous control actions.

items.title: Fast Planning for Multi-object Multi-target Throwing
items.summary: This research develops strategies for multi-object, multi-target throwing to improve efficiency in logistics and warehouse automation by enhancing throughput and expanding the workspace of throwing systems.

items.title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer
items.summary: RoboRender is a method for robot-oriented video generation that aims to bridge the sim-to-real gap for policies trained in simulation by reducing visual discrepancies.

items.title: Co${}^{2}$Skill: Whole-Body Control via Skill Composition for Long-Horizon Human-Environment Interaction
items.summary: This work presents Co²Skill, a framework for achieving whole-body control through skill composition, enabling complex long-horizon human-environment interaction for robots.

items.title: ClimbLab: MATLAB Simulation Platform for Legged Climbing Robotics
items.summary: This paper introduces ClimbLab, an open-sourced MATLAB simulation and analysis platform specifically designed for legged climbing robots, enabling the design and simulation of limbed robotic systems.

items.title: MCFR: A Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression Framework for Robust Multi-Variant Board-to-Board Connector Assembly
items.summary: This paper introduces MCFR, a mask-guided coarse-to-fine regression framework designed to achieve robust automated insertion of board-to-board connectors in 3C manufacturing despite variations.

items.title: COOL: Curiosity-Driven Object Ownership Learning for Personalized Robotic Assistance
items.summary: This paper introduces COOL, a curiosity-driven method enabling robots to learn object ownership and ground natural language commands for personalized assistance in everyday environments.

items.title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
items.summary: This research introduces Immiscible Diffusion Policy to preserve multimodal robot actions by addressing the issue of diffusion policies collapsing to a single modality, ensuring better action distribution.

items.title: TempoBridge: Language-Guided Tempo Control for Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.summary: TempoBridge is introduced as a lightweight framework that uses frozen VLA representations to provide language-guided tempo control, allowing for modulation of robot action execution speed.

items.title: RobotAPO: Adversarial Physics Preference Optimization for Robotic Manipulation Video Generation
items.summary: RobotAPO proposes an adversarial physics preference optimization method for robotic manipulation video generation, aiming to create visually plausible videos that also accurately capture real-world physical interactions.

items.title: TMT: Runtime Backdoor Detection for Vision-Language-Action Policies on Unseen Tasks
items.summary: TMT introduces a method for runtime backdoor detection in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, aiming to identify malicious actions triggered by specific inputs while maintaining benign task performance.

items.title: Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control
items.summary: This research proposes ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller designed for precise end-effector pose tracking, addressing challenges such as floating-base oscillations and dynamic coupling.

items.title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: This work investigates Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning to mitigate state hallucination in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, thereby improving the reliability of robotic manipulation in real-world environments.

items.title: MagCilia: A Compact Magnetociliary Tactile Sensor with 3D Force Sensing for Robotic Contact Perception and Grasping Feedback
items.summary: MagCilia is introduced as a compact magnetociliary tactile sensor with 3D force sensing capabilities, designed to enhance robotic contact perception and provide grasping feedback.

items.title: Targeted Modality Dropout for Real-Robot Manipulation Robust to Intermittent Vision Loss
items.summary: This paper introduces Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD) to enhance real-robot manipulation by making imitation learning policies more robust to intermittent vision loss.

items.title: Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots
items.summary: This research explores adaptive code generation for controlling robots, aiming to enable intention-based autonomy in dynamic environments by transitioning from rigid command libraries to natural language articulation of complex goals.

items.title: Fast and Robust Teach-and-Repeat Navigation Using MixVPR Visual Place Recognition*
items.summary: This paper presents a fast and robust teach-and-repeat navigation system for mobile robots, utilizing MixVPR visual place recognition techniques for localization in unstructured and dynamic environments.

items.title: Design optimization of tendon-driven robots considering tendon wrapping and shortcut
items.summary: This study proposes a multi-objective optimization method for the design of tendon-driven robot arms, balancing joint torque maximization and arm thickness minimization by considering tendon wrapping and shortcut effects.

items.title: RoboPace: Contact-Aware Time-Optimal Retiming for Action-Chunk Policies
items.summary: RoboPace introduces a contact-aware time-optimal retiming method for action-chunk policies, aiming to improve robot manipulation by adjusting the timing inherited from demonstrations.

items.title: YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding
items.summary: YUBI-STAG enhances Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by providing contact and semantic-rich alignment via automated video-language grounding, improving robot manipulation capabilities through fine-grained instruction mapping.

items.title: {\Delta}WAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models
items.summary: This research introduces $\Delta$WAM, a method for distilling action tangent fields into World Action Models (WAMs), aiming to improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction.

items.title: On-Demand Robotic Assembly via Differentiable Geometric Part Repair
items.summary: This paper introduces an autonomous pipeline for the design and physical construction of bespoke wooden assemblies, aiming to streamline the transition from digital design to robotic assembly.

items.title: Enhancing Robotic Perception and Adaptability through Sensor Fusion and Origami-Inspired Designs
items.summary: This research presents a compact mobile robot featuring origami-inspired wheels for locomotion and active control of its sensing geometry, enhancing perception and adaptability in varying environmental conditions.

items.title: Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching
items.summary: This research focuses on achieving accurate end-effector localization for robotic manipulation teaching, addressing challenges like camera occlusion in close-range robot demonstration learning.

items.title: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen Take Humanoid Robots From Quality Inspection Into Factory Logistics
items.summary: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen are collaborating to develop and test humanoid robots for factory logistics, expanding on the use of Walker S Lite for quality inspection.

items.title: AI firm HUMXN offers free plumbing and HVAC service in Minnesota to train robots
items.summary: AI firm HUMXN is offering free plumbing and HVAC services in Minnesota as a program to train its robots in real-world environments.

items.title: Generalizable Robustness Testing of DNN-Based Robotic Navigation Systems via XAI-Guided Search
items.summary: This paper presents a method for generalizable robustness testing of Deep Neural Network (DNN)-based robotic navigation systems using XAI-guided search, aiming to identify unsafe behaviors under input perturbations.

items.title: RMRRT: Riemannian Barrier Metric RRT for Inequality-Aware Steering on Equality Manifolds
items.summary: RMRRT introduces a Riemannian barrier metric RRT motion planning framework that unifies equality and inequality constraints for steering in high-dimensional robotic systems, improving geometric formulation for sampling-based planners.

items.title: Geometric Coherence via Weighted Matching for 3D Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reach-Avoid Games
items.summary: This research studies assignment quality in 3D heterogeneous multi-agent reach-avoid games, identifying 'Geometric Sprawl' as a failure mode of cardinality-only matching in structured scenarios.

items.title: Does a Learned Corrector Beat a Simple Retreat? Evidence from a Frozen VLA
items.summary: This study evaluates the effectiveness of a learned corrector for runtime recovery of a frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy in robot manipulation tasks within the Robosuite environment.

items.title: SWAP: Stepwise Action Policy Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: SWAP proposes a framework for stepwise action policy routing that dynamically composes multiple Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies during execution for robust robot manipulation systems.

items.title: ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception
items.summary: ROMA introduces an LLM system for real-world object-centric multi-sensory active perception, enabling AI systems to interact with the physical environment by actively acquiring and interpreting sensory information.

items.title: Learning Modular Policy for Multi-Floor Object Navigation:A Factorized Framework for Diagnostic Study
items.summary: This paper proposes a factorized framework with a learnable policy for object-goal navigation in multi-floor scenarios, addressing challenges posed by sparse rewards in long-horizon decision-making for robots.

items.title: ACG-WAM: World-Action Modeling via Action-Conditioned Geometric Latent Prediction
items.summary: ACG-WAM introduces a method for world-action modeling that jointly learns visual prediction and robot actions, providing explicit targets for the geometric consequences of demonstrated action sequences to improve policy learning.

items.title: ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration
items.summary: ProactiveVLA enhances robot adaptation to new environments by augmenting embodied memory through proactive exploration, allowing a reasoning agent combined with a vision-language-action model (VLA) to acquire useful knowledge.

items.title: LEAP: Making Privileged Geometry Supervision Effective for Visuomotor Learning
items.summary: LEAP explores how privileged 3D geometric supervision can effectively guide RGB-based visuomotor policy learning for robots during training, ensuring visual representations capture geometry useful for control without requiring geometric inputs at deployment.

items.title: BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
items.summary: BRACE addresses the challenge of whole-body motion tracking for humanoid robots by adapting reference motions to account for forces the robot exchanges with objects and the terrain it stands on, moving beyond level-ground assumptions.

items.title: Demo: Vision-Language Model-Guided Online Calibration of an Electromagnetic Digital Twin
items.summary: This demonstration showcases a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework for online calibration of an electromagnetic digital twin, which enhances mobile robots' wireless situational awareness by adapting to changing material conductivities.

items.title: TeleHairing: A Teleoperation Baseline for Robotic Haircutting
items.summary: TeleHairing presents a teleoperation baseline for robotic haircutting, focusing on controlled tool motion near the head and accounting for communication, visual feedback, and actuation, providing a reference for analyzing coupled behaviors.

items.title: AIM: Adaptive Interaction Modeling Networks for Real-to-Sim Soft-Body Simulation
items.summary: AIM proposes Adaptive Interaction Modeling Networks for real-to-sim soft-body simulation to support robotic manipulation tasks involving deformable objects, enabling robots to control shape changes and object motion.

items.title: What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot
items.summary: This paper explores semantic-aware locomotion and execution-aware navigation for humanoid robots, addressing limitations of elevation maps in identifying hazards and improving navigation capabilities in complex environments.

items.title: RACER: Residual-Adaptive Closed-Loop Estimation for Sampling-Based Planning in Wheeled-Quadruped Racing
items.summary: RACER is presented as a hierarchical control framework for wheeled-quadruped racing, combining an MPPI planner with a learned residual dynamics model and an RL velocity tracker to enhance performance and capture closed-loop dynamics.

items.title: MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation
items.summary: MobileVISTA proposes generative data augmentation to improve pose generalization in mobile manipulation tasks for robots, including humanoids, enabling them to perform dexterous tasks in dynamic environments despite limited demonstration data.

items.title: ProCut: Probabilistic Cutting Topology for Autonomous Electrosurgical Tissue Dissection
items.summary: ProCut introduces a probabilistic cutting topology approach for autonomous electrosurgical tissue dissection, aiming to accurately model and track the deformation of soft tissue during surgical procedures involving topological changes.

items.title: Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Researchers introduce TIGER, a reward-construction and pretraining framework for efficient reinforcement learning in sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: Seeing the Invisible: Physics-Guided Visual Prompting for Temperature- and Radiation-Aware VLA Navigation
items.summary: This paper explores physics-guided visual prompting for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to enable navigation in safety-critical environments with invisible risks like radiation or temperature spikes.

items.title: OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception
items.summary: OpenSplatGraph is presented as a method to convert dense semantic maps into structured scene graphs for improved open-vocabulary robotic perception in complex environments.

items.title: Learning Grasp Targeting from Point Clouds for Log Pile Clearing on a Hydraulic Crane
items.summary: This research details a learned policy for grasp targeting from point clouds, enabling a hydraulic crane to efficiently clear dense log piles in mill yards.

items.title: TacZero: Training-Free Peg Insertion Using a General-Purpose Vision-Language Model with Tactile Feedback
items.summary: TacZero enables training-free peg insertion by utilizing a general-purpose vision-language model with tactile feedback, allowing robots to autonomously perform contact-rich manipulation tasks.

items.title: SMART: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Articulated Object Manipulation via Large-Scale Synthetic Pretraining
items.summary: SMART is a method for zero-shot sim-to-real articulated object manipulation achieved through large-scale synthetic pretraining, addressing challenges in real-world data collection for embodied intelligent systems.

items.title: EigenDEXplore: Structured Exploration for Dexterous Manipulation with Human Priors
items.summary: EigenDEXplore proposes a structured exploration method incorporating human priors to tackle the high-dimensional optimization problem of dexterous manipulation in robotics.

items.title: CoRE: Learning Collaboration-Role Experts for Decentralized Collaborative Manipulation with One Policy
items.summary: CoRE (Collaboration-Role Experts) focuses on learning a single policy for decentralized collaborative manipulation, allowing multiple robots to perform complementary actions based on their individual observations.

items.title: Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization for Constrained Locomotion Planning
items.summary: This research presents a model-based geometry-aware generative optimization technique for constrained locomotion planning in quadrupeds and humanoids, addressing complex dynamics and environmental constraints.

items.title: Chinese Humanoid Robots Appear at South Korea's Parliamentary Audit… Physical AI Investment 'Woefully Inadequate' - BigGo Finance
items.summary: Chinese humanoid robots were showcased at a South Korean parliamentary audit, prompting concerns that physical AI investment in the country is insufficient.

items.title: Transfar Opens 300+ Industrial Scenarios to Embodied AI, From Chemical Plants to Logistics Parks
items.summary: Transfar is opening over 300 industrial sites as test grounds for training and deploying AI-powered physical robots and embodied AI systems.

items.title: Building a Streaming Robotics Learning Pipeline Using NVIDIA Cosmos3-DROID
items.summary: This article demonstrates how to build an end-to-end streaming learning pipeline for robotics using the NVIDIA Cosmos3-DROID dataset, leveraging techniques like behavior cloning and temporal ensembling.

items.title: A Tesla Veteran Is Running a Copper Mine with AI-Powered Robots
items.summary: A former Tesla executive is utilizing AI-powered robots to operate a copper mine in an industrial application.

items.title: Humanoid robot brings STEM lessons to life at Moose Jaw day camp - moosejawtoday.com
items.summary: A humanoid robot is being used to teach STEM lessons at a day camp in Moose Jaw.

items.title: The Humanoid Robot Future Has Arrived at a South Korean Park. Sort of.
items.summary: A South Korean park, Galaxy Robot Park in Seoul, is showcasing humanoid robots, offering a glimpse into a potential future with these machines.

items.title: The Humanoid Robot Future Has Arrived at a South Korean Park. Sort of. - The New York Times
items.summary: A South Korean park, Galaxy Robot Park in Seoul, is showcasing humanoid robots, offering a glimpse into a potential future with these machines.

items.title: Research could guide the future design of social robots
items.summary: New research from the University of Glasgow suggests that giving social robots animal-like or anime-style faces and voices could enhance their emotional appeal and guide future design in the field.

items.title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
items.summary: This paper introduces progressive visual planning for world action models (WAMs) to improve long-horizon prediction in robotic control. It addresses challenges in generating dense video rollouts for predicting future visual dynamics and actions.

items.title: SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces 'SoTa,' soft tactile skins designed to enhance robot policies with contact information, complementing vision for dexterous manipulation tasks and addressing the scarcity of visuo-tactile robot data.

items.title: Filter-Aware Fine-Tuning for Safe Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking
items.summary: This paper proposes a filter-aware fine-tuning method to ensure safe whole-body motion for humanoid robots, crucial for their deployment in unstructured environments, by optimizing reinforcement-learning policies to track references effectively.

items.title: SocialVLA: A Social Perception Gateway for Human-Reaction-Based Failure Detection and Recovery in VLA Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces SocialVLA, a system that uses human social reactions (vocal, facial, verbal) as a gateway for failure detection and recovery in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robotic manipulation policies, enabling robots to recognize and correct errors.

items.title: Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This paper proposes rethinking World-Action Models (WAMs) to better handle long-horizon compositional robotic manipulation by integrating explicit subtask-level representations into their joint prediction of visual futures and actions.

items.title: Keep the Effect, Drop the Actor: Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models
items.summary: This research introduces Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models that learn from robot demonstrations by focusing on the effect on objects (3D keypoint trajectories) rather than specific arm actions, compiling demonstrations into an effect program.

items.title: Autonomous mobile robot operations logistics: a dataset of jobs, dispatch events and robot states
items.summary: This paper presents MoRoOp, a dataset of autonomous mobile robot (AMR) operations in a laboratory kit preparation and supply scenario, detailing job generation, dispatch events, and robot states for production logistics applications.

items.title: RUL-Aware RRT*: Degradation-Balanced Motion Planning for Robotic Manipulators
items.summary: This research proposes RUL-Aware RRT*, a degradation-balanced motion planning algorithm for robotic manipulators that considers uneven joint degradation to prevent premature actuator failure and reduce operational losses during long-duration operations.

items.title: CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization
items.summary: CriticHack is a method for evaluating visual reward models used in robot policy optimization, demonstrating that these models can score incorrect actions highly and that optimizing such rewards can amplify wrong-object failures.

items.title: A Passive AI System for Verifying Physical State on Automated Liquid Handlers
items.summary: This paper introduces the Labware Setup Checker, a passive vision AI system designed to verify the physical setup and deck preparation on automated liquid handlers like the Opentrons Flex, ensuring that the physical arrangement matches digital protocols.

items.title: DeltaWorld: Physically Consistent Interactive World Simulators via Action-Conditioned Latent Increment Learning
items.summary: DeltaWorld proposes interactive world simulators that generate physically consistent future image sequences for robot planning, policy training, and evaluation, achieved through action-conditioned latent increment learning to predict action consequences.

items.title: GeoScaffold: Learning Compact Geometric Latents via Reconstruction for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
items.summary: GeoScaffold proposes learning compact geometric latents via reconstruction to improve the efficiency of Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) systems, enhancing 3D geometric priors for streaming Video-LLM policies that map observations and instructions to actions.

items.title: AdaTempo: Learning Shared Relative Tempo from Demonstrations for Faster Robot Manipulation
items.summary: AdaTempo is a self-supervised method that learns shared relative tempo from demonstrations, enabling visuomotor policies to achieve faster robot manipulation by optimizing the timing inherited from teleoperated demonstrations.

items.title: CSIR: Contextually and Socially Informed Robots for Efficient Person Goal Navigation
items.summary: CSIR (Contextually and Socially Informed Robots) addresses the Person Goal Navigation problem by enabling robots to efficiently search for people, incorporating contextual and social information to overcome limitations like information accessibility and language uncertainty.

items.title: Proprioceptive Sketches as Long-Horizon Intent for Generative Action Policies
items.summary: This paper proposes using proprioceptive sketches to provide long-horizon intent for generative robot policies, addressing their current limitation of predicting only short action chunks without explicit future goals, thereby improving robot motion.

items.title: SimpleTouch: Can Vision-Language-Action Models Master Contact-Rich Manipulation Without Tactile Policy Pretraining?
items.summary: SimpleTouch investigates whether Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can effectively master contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks without the need for prior tactile policy pretraining, exploring challenges in integrating tactile sensing.

items.title: LOCUS: Landmark-Oriented Container Discrimination Using Spatial Graphs
items.summary: Presents LOCUS, a method that uses spatial graphs for robots to discriminate between containers and reason about object relationships for robust manipulation and navigation in unstructured environments.

items.title: SARI: Phase-Split Sim-Real Co-Training for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.summary: Proposes SARI (Simulated Approach, Real Interaction), a sim-real co-training framework designed to make Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models more adaptable to contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
items.summary: Introduces FastOPD, an on-policy distillation method aimed at reducing the computational costs of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models for lightweight, real-world robotic manipulation deployment.

items.title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: Introduces PointWAM, a 3D world action modeling approach for dexterous robotic manipulation that learns to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions using 3D representations.

items.title: Permutation Robustness Is Not Enough: Action Collapse in Multi-Agent Transformer Policies
items.summary: Investigates how the mismatch between unordered multi-agent teams and ordered transformer token sequences leads to 'action collapse' in multi-agent robot learning policies for cooperative navigation.

items.title: MixVLA: Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: Proposes MixVLA, a method to improve the zero-shot generalization of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation by adaptively mixing invariant and non-invariant information.

items.title: Safe Streaming Flow Planning by Aligning Sampling Dynamics with Execution Dynamics
items.summary: Addresses safe streaming flow planning for generative AI planners, focusing on aligning sampling and execution dynamics to enforce safety constraints and enable online replanning for real-world deployment of physical systems.

items.title: Beyond Reward Hacking: Proxy Divergence Across Four Layers of a Staged Humanoid Learning Pipeline
items.summary: Examines proxy divergence within a staged reinforcement learning pipeline for legged robots, analyzing how different proxies for behavior, competence, robustness, and skill contribute to humanoid learning.

items.title: Equivariant Visual-Tactile Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.summary: Proposes VISTA, an equivariant visual-tactile diffusion policy designed for data-efficient imitation learning in contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks, reducing the need for extensive expert data.

items.title: KungfuAthleteBot: learning high-dynamic humanoid motion from video with unified robust recovery
items.summary: Introduces KungfuAthleteBot, a method for enabling humanoid robots to learn and perform high-dynamic athletic motions from video data, addressing challenges of physical consistency and robust recovery.

items.title: I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry
items.summary: Presents I2CD, a direct image-to-convex decomposition method that efficiently converts outputs from image-to-3D generative models into simulation-ready convex collision geometry for physics simulators and motion planners.

items.title: XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation
items.summary: Introduces XGenAct, a geometry-enhanced world action model that improves robot control and manipulation by incorporating cross-task generation, enhancing spatial understanding beyond basic predictions.

items.title: Autonomous Robotic Navigation for Endovascular Brain-Computer Interface Access
items.summary: This work demonstrates autonomous robotic navigation for endovascular brain-computer interface access, involving a physical robotic system performing precise manipulation for medical procedures.

items.title: RATE: Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding for Contact-rich Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces Risk-Aware Tactile Encoding (RATE) to improve contact-rich robotic manipulation through better tactile sensing and representation learning for physical robots.

items.title: World Action Learning via Interaction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance
items.summary: This research explores a method for learning general-purpose robot policies and robotic manipulation using interaction-centric spectral latent guidance from egocentric videos.

items.title: Bridging Frontier Reasoning and Robot Execution: From Autonomous Demonstration Generation to Dense Language Supervision
items.summary: This work explores approaches to bridge frontier AI reasoning with low-latency robot execution and manipulation, including autonomous demonstration generation and language supervision for robots.

items.title: CORNAV: Construction-Aware Reasoning for Robot Navigation on Active Worksites
items.summary: CORNAV introduces construction-aware reasoning for autonomous robot navigation on active worksites, aiming to improve efficiency and safety for physical robots in the construction industry.

items.title: Agent memory the human can still audit: primary sources, epistemic status markers, and user sign-off
items.summary: A new tool is being developed to provide AI agents with auditable memory, emphasizing human oversight through primary sources and epistemic status markers for safety and alignment.

items.title: Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions
items.summary: Microsoft researchers discovered that clearing an AI agent's chat history, while retaining its workspace, helps it escape "idea basins" and find better solutions, improving results by up to 66%.

items.title: DeepSeek’s cost cuts may affect AI model's accuracy: Study | Designed to save memory by compressing models | Inshorts - Inshorts
items.summary: A study suggests that DeepSeek's cost-cutting measures, which involve compressing AI models to save memory, may negatively impact the models' accuracy. The focus is on the technical trade-offs between memory efficiency and model performance.

items.title: DeepSeek Solves AI Memory Problem with Compression - Geeky Gadgets
items.summary: DeepSeek claims to have solved an AI memory problem by utilizing compression techniques.

items.title: DP-MIND: Differentially private memory-guided Long context Inference
items.summary: This item introduces 'DP-MIND,' a method for differentially private memory-guided long-context inference in LLM-as-a-Service to address privacy concerns with sensitive user queries.

items.title: Forgetting is Not Always Bad: A Neuro-Inspired Memory Repair Mechanism for Poisoned LLM Agents
items.summary: This research proposes a neuro-inspired memory repair mechanism for poisoned LLM agents, offering a more efficient defense against memory-poisoning attacks than existing external modules.

items.title: Temporal Evidence Forests for Long-Horizon Multi-Party Conversational Memory
items.summary: This paper introduces Temporal Evidence Forests as a new mechanism for long-term multi-party conversational memory in LLM-based agents, supporting persistent interaction and personalized assistance.

items.title: KV-Repurpose: A Testbed for Evaluating Non-Prefix KV-Cache Reuse
items.summary: This paper introduces KV-Repurpose, an open-source vLLM-based testbed for evaluating non-prefix KV-cache reuse in large language model serving, which typically limits reuse to exact prompt prefixes.

items.title: Test-Time Memory Construction
items.summary: This research introduces "Test-Time Memory Construction" to help Large Language Models answer questions over long interaction histories by dynamically building memory during inference. It aims to overcome limitations of traditional offline memory systems for LLMs.

items.title: CORAL-KV: Compact Cross-Layer Prediction and Residual Coding for Autoregressive Video KV Caches
items.summary: This paper presents CORAL-KV, a method utilizing compact cross-layer prediction and residual coding to compress attention key-value (KV) caches in autoregressive video diffusion models, addressing memory bottlenecks in long video generation.

items.title: What Should Embodied Agents Remember? Benchmarking and Evaluating Memory Modality for Embodied Agents
items.summary: This paper benchmarks and evaluates various memory modalities for embodied agents, exploring how AI systems store and recall visual and spatial information to improve their performance.

items.title: Gamma: Grounded Multi-Agent Memory with Mechanical Audit for Memory-Intensive Manipulation
items.summary: Gamma introduces a grounded multi-agent memory system with mechanical audit, designed to enhance memory-intensive manipulation capabilities for vision-language-action policies.

items.title: JulianFlux: Electrodynamic vector retrieval and causal routing for AI
items.summary: JulianFlux introduces an approach to 'electrodynamic vector retrieval and causal routing' for AI, focusing on mechanisms for storing and recalling information.

items.title: Show HN: Try Free Long-Term Memory for AI 50M-Token Window
items.summary: A new tool offers free long-term memory for AI systems, featuring a 50-million-token context window.

items.title: Show HN: Memdebug – See what changed in your AI agent's memory, and undo it
items.summary: Memdebug is a tool that allows developers to visualize changes in an AI agent's memory and provides functionality to undo those changes. Its primary focus is on debugging and managing AI system memory.

items.title: Kairos Experiment – How I disproved my own AI memory framework
items.summary: The "Kairos Experiment" describes how the author disproved their own proposed AI memory framework. This relates to the mechanisms by which AI systems store and recall information.

items.title: ByteDance researchers identify cause of inconsistent long-context retrieval in DeepSeek models
items.summary: ByteDance researchers identified that chunked KV-cache compression causes inconsistent long-context retrieval in DeepSeek models by making retrieval accuracy sensitive to information placement within compression windows.

items.title: Curating Always-Loaded Context for LLM Agents: A Capacitated Assortment Model with Censored Feedback
items.summary: Introduces a capacitated assortment model with censored feedback for curating always-loaded context files in LLM agents to improve performance and cost efficiency.

items.title: What to Admit and How to Present: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents
items.summary: Discusses two governance decisions, admission and presentation, for managing persistent memory in LLM agents to improve personalization while mitigating issues like sycophancy.

items.title: RIT-RAG: Navigating Document Corpora with Retrieval-Induced Trees
items.summary: RIT-RAG enhances retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems by introducing Retrieval-Induced Trees, allowing agentic RAG to navigate document corpora more effectively and leverage document structure for better evidence distinction.

items.title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
items.summary: This paper proposes 'Gated Memory,' an admission-controlled mechanism for memory formation in conversational AI, focusing on how facts are selected and written to persistent storage systems.

items.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
items.summary: This paper introduces REMORY, a neural memory network designed for context compaction in long-horizon agents, supplementing textual summaries with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens.

items.title: From Retrieval to Reconstruction: Constructing Evolvable Cognitive Memory for Long-Term Dialogue
items.summary: This research proposes constructing evolvable cognitive memory systems for long-term dialogue agents, moving beyond passive storage in existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks. The goal is to support reliable reasoning over extended interactions by allowing memory to be reconstructed.

items.title: Beyond Sequences: Distilling Structured Decision Memory for LLM Recommendation
items.summary: This research proposes distilling structured decision memory for Large Language Model recommendation systems, moving beyond modeling single-type behaviors or flattening heterogeneous actions into homogeneous token sequences. items.title: ByteDance Seed Paper Finds a 'Phase Sensitivity' Blind Spot in Chunked KV-Cache Compression

items.summary: Research explores methods for achieving long-term memory in AI with a 50-million-token context window, positing it as a faster and cheaper alternative to recomputation.

items.title: Give Your Agent Context Before You Buy an AI SRE
items.summary: An article advises providing AI agents with sufficient context, linking to concepts like context windows and retrieval mechanisms for effective AI Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).

items.summary: An article discusses the absence of robust data and memory layers for AI agents and presents a newly developed solution to address this gap.

items.title: KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression
items.summary: This paper introduces KVFetch, a temporal prefetching method designed to enhance KV cache compression for efficient LLM inference. It addresses limitations in existing KV cache management techniques for large context windows.

items.title: Cache the Encoder Within:Compact, Reusable Memory across LLM Queries
items.summary: This paper proposes EncBank, a method that caches and compactly stores the outputs of a pretrained LLM's lower layers as a reusable document encoder to provide compact and reusable memory across repeated LLM queries.

items.title: ExperienceIndex: Artifact-Grounded Memory
items.summary: This paper presents ExperienceIndex, an artifact-grounded memory system designed to accumulate and leverage experiential knowledge from interactions with shared corpora for knowledge-intensive tasks.

items.title: Rethinking access control for RAG with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: The article discusses how Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases enhance enterprise RAG by enforcing real-time, document-level access controls within complex knowledge sources.

items.title: Understanding and Mitigating Inference-Time Overreliance Using Agentic Memory
